title: TRACEGUARD: Structured Multi-Dimensional Monitoring as a Collusion-Resistant Control Protocol
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical 'AI control problem,' specifically detecting malicious actions (such as data exfiltration or privilege escalation) by untrusted AI agents. While it uses the AgentHarm dataset to evaluate performance on 'harmful behavior,' its focus is on suspicion scoring and collusion resistance in a control protocol, rather than evaluating religious, spiritual, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
